  Extract applies `_socrata_where_precise` (verbatim vocabulary scan

  ownership — earliest matching group wins; the generic window emits

  rows record `precise_count`/`dropped_count`/pruned counts honestly,
  including zero. Normalize fans out every populated `desc_fields`

  USAspending recipients drop on the record's type literal or the

## Deviations

- Fallback dedupe lives in a pure per-record ownership rule
  (`_socrata_like_owner`) rather than normalize-time cross-capture
  state: `replay()`/`run_post_capture()` normalize each capture
  independently, so a run-level mutable ledger could not see all
  captures; the owning `where` group is a deterministic function of the
  record itself. Recorded, not a contract change.
- The deterministic-replay test's baseline uses `run_post_capture()`
  per capture (the real parse → extract → normalize → link path), not a
  bare `normalize()` — link-stage `object_ref` stamps differ otherwise
  (2-claim diff found and fixed in the test, not the implementation).
- Existing CROL fixture tests now serve fixture rows through the owning
  `surveillance` where target — every fixture row matches that group,
  so the generic window correctly prunes them; notices emit from the
  tighter tier, which is the intended surface.
- `text_claim_digests.json` re-goldened on the `usaspending_awards`
  partner run only — the intentional P35.9 recipient-drop + widened-
  slice claims; the fixture note records the reason.
- Planning-reference discrepancy noted, not silently resolved: the
  acquisition CSV lookup showed `ap-t2-105` on unrelated DOT rows; the
  authoritative ticket catalog row is `R11-ACQ-05`. Left for the parent
  to confirm against the planning source; no file was changed on this
  point.
- Recorded skip-gap escape, fixed forward: `tests/db/
  test_partner_entity_refs.py::test_person_shaped_and_ambiguous_
  partners_mint_nothing` pinned the pre-P8-6 contract (the refused
  literal always stands as its text claim); under the recipient drop
  `JOHN Q CITIZEN` correctly emits no claim at all. The test is
  Docker-gated and skipped silently on this daemon-less checkout (the
  recorded 501-skip posture), so only CI's `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`
  python job reached it — impl head `b8ef2a83` red (run 38086868272,
  1 failed / 7,990 passed), repaired in `f88aeb37` (the assertion now
  pins the new contract: the two govspend literals stand, the
  person-shaped USAspending literal lands zero claims). The connectors
  suite had already covered the drop markers; the DB-layer pin was the
  stale one.
- No new ADR — the row executes the ticket contract; the ownership-rule
  shape is recorded here as the deviation note, not a contract change.
